project: THC Hardware Scanner & Remote Audit Hub

cybersecurity_compliance.remote_code_execution: Disabled (Immutable typed command set: scan, uninstall)
cybersecurity_compliance.wmi_access: Strictly Read-Only (Win32_Processor, Win32_ComputerSystem, Win32_OperatingSystem, Win32_DiskDrive, Win32_PhysicalMemory)
cybersecurity_compliance.privilege_level: Standard User or Managed Service (Runs with scheduled task privileges for full hardware serial access)

operational_model: Admin On-Demand Pull. Clients remain in silent low-overhead standby heartbeat; hardware scan is dispatched only when the system administrator clicks pull from the web console.

arguments./service: Run as background standby daemon polling for admin scan commands
arguments./install: Install automatically to Program Files and create scheduled task
arguments./uninstall: Cleanly remove service and scheduled task
arguments./auto: Execute single hardware scan, send telemetry to API, and exit immediately
